monitoring_items: Native replay semantic verdict distribution for any later retest.

drift_watch: Advanced technique activation becoming default ceremony on direct tasks.
Tool call success being phrased as task success.
Partial state being phrased as completed state.
codex_runtime_watch: codex/skills remain independent runtime packages and not 00~04 mirrors.
Text parity is not introduced as a release criterion.
Backport candidates are routed through source-of-truth review before doctrine adoption.
primary_source_validation_follow_up: Continue official-source validation for deferred model/API/tool/current-fact items before stronger factual claims.
Keep deferred items marked Need Verification or scoped out until validated.
sandbox_telemetry_containment_follow_up: Collect containment proof before containment-verified language.
Collect production-grade telemetry summary, drift report, and rollback/escalation decision before production-monitored language.
Keep local trace evidence separate from production telemetry.
rollback_condition: Rollback to v34 if P0, release-blocking regression, source/runtime boundary collapse, or load-bearing release-language overclaim is detected.
